_comment: Collector configuration (roadmap step 2.1). Feed and listing 'source' values must match a registry source name exactly. Verified 2026-10-02. Sites that block automated access (kam.lt, kariuomene.lt, reuters.com) and sources with no feed (NATO) are intentionally absent. RFE/RL is in the registry for citation only: its robots.txt disallows /api/*, where all its feeds live.
_fetch_full_text: Master switch for article-page fetching (workers/collector/article.mts). A feed or listing must also opt in with full_text: true, which is set only for sources whose robots.txt and terms allow it (docs/decisions.md, decision 16) or by the owner's decision (decision 17). full_text_free_only limits a feed to items it marks pay_status Free. Only items that passed the keyword and region filters are fetched, through HttpClient (robots.txt, rate limits), at most full_text_max_pages per run; text is cut at full_text_max_chars, and text shorter than full_text_min_chars is not used.
_no_ai_processing_sources: Registry sources that are not collected directly but whose rows (for example GDELT results from their domain) must carry no_ai_processing. Feeds flagged with no_ai_processing are added to this set automatically.
_lead_only_sources: Registry sources whose rows (for example GDELT results from their domain) must carry lead_only. Feeds flagged with lead_only are added to this set automatically.
_citation_only_sources: Registry sources that may be cited by a person but are never fetched or processed by a worker (for example the historical suggester).
_blocked_automated_access: Domains no worker fetches or sends to a model, because the site blocks automated access. These sites' terms were not read; the entry records the blocking, not a terms decision. lrvk.lrv.lt answers HTTP 403 even for robots.txt; ve.lt's robots.txt blocks Anthropic's crawlers (decision 16); pagd.lrv.lt answers HTTP 403 to robots.txt, and the robots.txt of pap.pl and news.postimees.ee blocks Anthropic's crawlers (decision 19). Subdomains are included.
_tos_prohibited_domains: Domains no worker fetches or sends to a model, because their terms were read and prohibit automated aggregation or AI use of their content (decision 9: Telegram's Content Licensing and AI Scraping terms and API terms section 1.5; Discord's ban on self-bots; jauns.lv's terms forbid indexing, copying and analytical use, decision 16; bundeswehr.de, fontanka.ru and spiegel.de forbid automated reading or reserve text and data mining, decision 19). Subdomains are included.
_region_terms: Used by feeds with region_filter: an item must match a keyword AND one of these to be stored as NEW. Word-start match, so Belarus also matches Belarusian.
_region_terms_pl: Polish region stems, also accepted by every region filter (rp.pl, Defence24, the Polish MoD listing). Diacritics are folded on both sides and each stem must match at a word start, so polsk matches Polska and polskie, lotw matches Łotwa, baltyk matches Bałtyku. Write stems without diacritics; polacy rather than polac, which would match połączenie.
_region_terms_local: Region stems for feeds in Lithuanian, Latvian and Russian (by the feed's language), added to region_terms and region_terms_pl. Folded and matched at a word start like the Polish stems (Cyrillic folds й→и, ё→е, so балти matches Балтийск).
_keyword_stems_local: Used instead of keywords by Lithuanian (stem_filter lt) and Latvian (stem_filter lv) feeds, with keyword_whole_words_pl (NATO, Zapad). Folded and matched at a word start like the Polish stems; write them without diacritics. macibas is the whole plural (exercises), so the singular mācību (study) does not match.
_keyword_stems_ru: Used instead of keywords by Russian-language feeds with stem_filter ru, with keyword_whole_words_ru (case-sensitive abbreviations). Folded and matched at a word start (й→и, ё→е). учения/учении/учениях rather than учени, which would match ученик (pupil); Запад is left out because it also means the West.
_keyword_stems_pl: Used instead of keywords by Polish feeds with polish_filter. Diacritics are folded on both sides (ł→l, ż→z, ...), then each stem must match at a word start, so bialorus matches Białoruś, Białorusi and białoruski. Write stems without diacritics.
_keyword_whole_words_pl: Also used by polish_filter: whole words, case-sensitive, no folding. As stems these would match common words (nato → natomiast, zapad → zapadła).
_known_outlets: Used by feeds with extract_credits: outlet names recognized in phrases like "according to Reuters" or "Reuters reported". Registry source names are added automatically.

feeds._comment: Ukrainian general news with full text in the feed: an item needs a keyword and a region term in its title or first 500 characters (match_chars), so passing mentions further down do not count.
Lithuanian general news: an item needs a Lithuanian keyword stem (keyword_stems_lt, plus NATO/Zapad) and a region term. Full text by the owner's decision (decision 17).

Russian state-aligned outlet (decision 18). The feed carries titles only, so rows are metadata only and never reach the extractor; they are leads, and any claim from it must be attributed. No full text: its terms forbid copying full materials. Region filter on titles (region_terms_ru).
war.gov's own news feed (Site=945; every link is on war.gov). Public information (decision 19). Worldwide news: keyword and region term in the title or first 500 characters.

Russian state source, CC BY 4.0 (decision 19). The feed carries the full text, so no article pages are fetched; keyword and region term in the title or first 500 characters. Claims are attributed, never stated as fact.
Polish national news; terms forbid commercial copying only (decision 19). Polish keyword and region stems.
Regional public radio for the Lublin province, which borders Belarus and Ukraine (decision 19). The feed carries the full text, so no article pages are fetched.
No terms page found; robots.txt allows our client and Anthropic's crawlers (decision 19). Keyword and region term in the title or first 500 characters.
Independent investigative outlet; terms allow use with an active hyperlink (decision 19). The feed carries the full text, so no article pages are fetched. Russian keyword and region stems.
Estonian English-language outlet; personal-use terms, enabled by the owner's decision (decision 19). Keyword and region filters; full text on.
Polish maritime news; terms require written consent for copying, enabled by the owner's decision (decision 19). Polish keyword and region stems; full text on.

Independent Belarusian outlet (Russian-language). Enabled by the owner's decision with feed text only: its pages answer HTTP 403 to our client, so no article pages are fetched (decision 19). Russian keyword and region stems.
Latvia's national CERT: items are Latvia-specific, so no keyword or region filter. Terms silent (no terms page), robots.txt allows our client and Anthropic's crawlers (decision 16).

listings._comment: Reads only the 'Aktualnosci' (news) section of the MoD's own page; /web/obrona-narodowa/wiadomosci shows a gov.pl-wide carousel with almost no MoD items.
RCB alerts and news from the 'Aktualnosci' section of its gov.pl page. Poland-specific, so no region filter. gov.pl text is CC BY-SA 4.0 (decision 16).

gdelt._comment: GDELT DOC 2.0 API. Free, no key. Terms require citing the GDELT Project with a link to https://www.gdeltproject.org/ on any use or redistribution. Results are leads (metadata only), not verified events.
gdelt._rate_limit: GDELT's 429 message: 'Please limit requests to one every 5 seconds'. The gap is counted from when each response finishes.

queries.query: (Kaliningrad OR Suwalki OR "Baltic Fleet" OR "air policing") (military OR army OR troops OR exercise OR missile OR navy OR NATO OR drone)
(Belarus OR Belarusian) (troops OR "military exercise" OR mobilization OR "border guard" OR Wagner OR Zapad)

gdelt._lead_only: GDELT rows whose domain is not in the registry, or belongs to a lead_only_sources entry, carry metadata.lead_only = true; later steps skip them by default.

_no_ai_processing: Sources with no_ai_processing: true are stored as usual, but their rows carry metadata.no_ai_processing so later steps treat them as leads only and never send their text to an AI model. Set for sources whose robots.txt blocks AI crawlers when chosen.
